description: Six builder stories: launches, safeguards, open models, agents.
lead: A week with four flagship launches left buyers dizzy, defenders got new cyber models with strings attached, and the most useful guidance for builders was about running things locally and locking down agents. This digest collects six stories worth your time: release-cadence fatigue, cyber safeguards with gated access, a coding-agent security roundup, open-model rankings with a local angle, a practical self-host guide, and agent-team news. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 8, 2026: launches, models, safety
